name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions (fact-keeping fork: dropped calls keep their facts, never erased).

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: typesafe, openrouter, vercel or custom. Never inferred from credentials or baseUrl.

allowThirdPartyEgress.title: Allow third-party Jev egress
allowThirdPartyEgress.description: Explicitly permit sending fitted history, goal and questions to the selected third-party service and its model provider. Secret masking does not remove all confidential data.

apiKey.title: Selected service API key
apiKey.description: Key issued for the selected service. Otherwise use only TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY for its provider; custom requires an explicit key.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: Full System One endpoint, not an SDK prefix. Named providers require their exact endpoint; other URLs require provider custom and an explicit key. Remote custom requires allowThirdPartyEgress true. HTTPS or explicit loopback HTTP; no userinfo.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history when the context window's fill is unknown; otherwise the window decides.

compactionTimeoutMs.title: Jev round deadline
compactionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for all Jev batches in milliseconds (a number of at least 1000). A timeout falls back to the built-in summary; invalid values use 120000 ms.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result head kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; the fork also keeps the fact lines and a short tail.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Leave unset for the provider default: jev-latest for typesafe/openrouter/custom, typesafe-ai/jev for vercel. Explicit values are validated and never rewritten.

saveFullOutputs.title: Save full outputs
saveFullOutputs.description: Save the full output of every tool result a compaction reduces, secret values masked, under .claude/fast-jev/cache/<session>/ in the project (git-ignored, kept 30 days), and point its note there.
